body.name: role
body.description: One vacancy a client has asked us to fill, with its terms, fee basis and status. This is the job order. Candidates are submitted against it. A client company has many roles over time.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Job title and client name, for example Finance manager at Client name.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.role}.

body.name: submission
body.description: One candidate considered for one role. It moves through the placement pipeline from sourced to placed or rejected, and holds the fee earned if the candidate starts.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Candidate name and role, for example Candidate name for Finance manager.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.submission}.
